description: We are two students from Casablanca, Morocco. We chose this challenge because of where we live: in 2011 a piece of Mars fell out of the sky near Tissint, and we grew up a few hours from one of the most Mars-like deserts on Earth. So we spent the hackathon teaching a machine to scan our own country with NASA's data — and it surprised us: its top discovery was a place neither of us had ever heard of. RED ATLAS is our answer. Open source, bilingual, and built so that any country can rerun it and find its own analogs.
